definitions: A formal examination of evidence by a judge, and often a jury, in order to decide if a person accused of a crime is guilty or not.
A test of the performance, qualities, or suitability of someone or something.
A person or thing that causes difficulty or annoyance.
A sporting contest in which competitors attempt to achieve the best performance in a series of tests.
examples: The trial is expected to last three weeks.
They conducted a trial of the new drug.
The Olympic trials are next month.
